rules.name: ouat178-uat-touched-since-migration
rules.sql: SELECT 'security_info_table WP CFS' AS tbl, count(*) AS row_count, min(created_by) AS created_by_min, max(created_by) AS created_by_max, max(updated_by) AS updated_by_max, min(created_timestamp) AS created_min, max(created_timestamp) AS created_max, max(updated_timestamp) AS updated_max, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff) AS created_after, count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) AS updated_after FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' UNION ALL SELECT 'vol_id_table QW SB', count(*), min(created_by), max(created_by), max(updated_by), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), max(updated_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff), count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE vol_id LIKE 'CM QW%' OR vol_id LIKE 'CM SB%' UNION ALL SELECT 'var_price_vol_table QW SB settlement date', count(*), min(created_by), max(created_by), max(updated_by), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), max(updated_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff), count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE settlement_date = :sd AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%') UNION ALL SELECT 'underlying_settle_value_table W QW SB settlement date', count(*), min(created_by), max(created_by), max(updated_by), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), max(updated_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff), count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date <= :sd AND (underlying_id LIKE 'CM W %' OR underlying_id LIKE 'CM QW%' OR underlying_id LIKE 'CM SB%') UNION ALL SELECT 'cso_zero_rate_curve_table CFS USD', count(*), min(created_by), max(created_by), max(updated_by), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), max(updated_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff), count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) FROM opera.cso_zero_rate_curve_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND currency = 'USD' AND settle_date = :sd UNION ALL SELECT 'correl_product_mapping CFS', count(*), min(created_by), max(created_by), max(updated_by), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), max(updated_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff), count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'valuation_date_table CFS', count(*), min(created_by), max(created_by), max(updated_by), min(created_timestamp), max(created_timestamp), max(updated_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_timestamp >= :cutoff), count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_timestamp >= :cutoff) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT security_id, maturity_date, strike, status, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' ORDER BY security_id

SELECT created_timestamp::date AS created_day, created_by, count(*) AS security_rows FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND created_timestamp >= :from_day GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
